title: The Falling Upward
text: The ground lets go of you. Slowly, gently, the party begins to fall upward, boots leaving the earth, packs floating, toward a sky that is made of other ground, fields and roads hanging upside down far above. Your stomach does not like it at all.

options.label: Swim through the air toward the far ground.

outcomes.text: You land on the far side, a long way on, retching.
You land somewhere else, upside down, and something there was expecting you.

options.label: The strongest grabs a rock and holds everyone on.

outcomes.text: The world settles back down. Their arms do not.
Up, and up, and over, and down again, and all of you shaking, and somehow wiser.
